name: Kawung
description: Javanese batik ovals, four to a cell pointing into the corners, each with an oval eye, closing into four-petaled flowers with a seed at every center.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @var(--seeds); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -25%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-mask: @var(--ovals); mask: @var(--ovals); -webkit-transform: rotate(45deg); transform: rotate(45deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -25%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-mask: @var(--ovals); mask: @var(--ovals); -webkit-transform: rotate(-45deg); transform: rotate(-45deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --ovals: radial-gradient(ellipse 11.3% 21.3% at 50% 26.4%, transparent 0 42%, #000 42% 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 11.3% 21.3% at 50% 73.6%, transparent 0 42%, #000 42% 100%, transparent 100%); --seeds: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 50% 50%, var(--color1) 13%, transparent 13%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, var(--color1) 6.5%, transparent 6.5%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 0, var(--color1) 6.5%, transparent 6.5%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 100%, var(--color1) 6.5%, transparent 6.5%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 100%, var(--color1) 6.5%, transparent 6.5%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
